SELECT fished_date_season AS season,
       cls,
       CASE WHEN fished_date_doy BETWEEN 213 AND 243 THEN 'Aug'
            WHEN fished_date_doy BETWEEN 244 AND 273 THEN 'Sep'
            WHEN fished_date_doy BETWEEN 274 AND 304 THEN 'Oct'
            WHEN fished_date_doy BETWEEN 305 AND 334 THEN 'Nov'
            ELSE 'other' END AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS boat_days,
       SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers,
       SUM(yt) AS total_yt,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
  AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 213 AND 334
  AND fished_date_season <= 6
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 1,3,2
